brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. The doctor completed all 7 RC items, including proper acute symptom assessment, safe medication guidance, and clear escalation criteria. Multiple high-order points were completed: real-world constraint navigation (HO1) via staged nearest-facility guidance, responsibility-chain repair (HO2) via persistent engagement through care transitions, patient-state-sensitive communication (HO3) via clear red-flag lists and emotional support, and safe bounded closure (HO4) via proper episode closure with residual risks acknowledged. Trajectory demonstrates excellent clinical reasoning and safety recognition over a multi-day episode.
